title: See What Matters: Differentiable Grid Sample Pruning for Generalizable Vision-Language-Action Model
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown remarkable promise in robotics manipulation, yet their high computational cost hinders real-time deployment. Existing token pruning methods suffer from a fundamental trade-off: aggressive compression using pruning inevitably discards critical geometric details like contact points, leading to severe performance degradation. This forces a compromise, limiting the achievable compression rate and thus the potential speedup. We argue that breaking this trade-off requires rethinking compression as a geometry-aware, continuous token resampling in the vision encoder. To this end, we propose the Differentiable Grid Sampler (GridS), a plug-and-play module that performs task-aware, continuous resampling of visual tokens in VLA. By adaptively predicting a minimal set of salient coordinates and extracting features via differentiable interpolation, GridS preserves essential spatial information while achieving drastic compression (with fewer than 10% original visual tokens). Experiments on both LIBERO benchmark and a real robotic platform demonstrate that validating the lowest feasible visual token count reported to date, GridS achieves a 76% reduction in FLOPs with no degradation in the success rate. The code is available at https://github.com/Fediory/Grid-Sampler.
tldr: This paper proposes GridS, a differentiable grid sampler for VLA models that adaptively resamples visual tokens to drastically reduce computation while preserving critical geometric details for manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了GridS，一种用于VLA模型的可微分网格采样器，可自适应地重采样视觉tokens，在保留操控任务关键几何细节的同时大幅减少计算量。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型在机器人操作领域展现出巨大潜力，但其高昂的计算成本阻碍了实时部署。现有的令牌剪枝方法存在一个根本性矛盾：通过剪枝进行激进压缩不可避免地会丢失接触点等关键几何细节，导致性能严重下降。这迫使系统作出妥协，限制了可实现的压缩率及潜在的加速效果。我们认为，打破这一矛盾需要将压缩重新构想为视觉编码器中几何感知的连续令牌重采样方法。为此，我们提出可微分网格采样器——一种即插即用模块，可在视觉-语言-动作模型中执行任务感知的连续视觉令牌重采样。通过自适应预测最小化的显著坐标集合并借助可微分插值提取特征，该方案在实现极致压缩的同时保持了关键空间信息。在LIBERO基准测试和真实机器人平台上的实验表明，本方法以当前已知最低的视觉令牌数量实现了浮点运算量减少76%且成功率不降的性能，验证了其有效性。代码已开源。

title: SafeManip: A Property-Driven Benchmark for Temporal Safety Evaluation in Robotic Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation is typically evaluated by task success, but successful completion does not guarantee safe execution. Many safety failures are temporal: a robot may touch a clean surface after contamination or release an object before it is fully inside an enclosure. We introduce SafeManip, a property-driven benchmark to explicitly evaluate temporal safety properties in robotic manipulation, moving beyond prior evaluations that largely focus on task completion or per-state constraint violations. SafeManip defines reusable safety templates over finite executions using Linear Temporal Logic over finite traces (LTLf). It maps observed rollouts to symbolic predicate traces and evaluates them with LTLf-based monitors. Its property suite covers eight manipulation safety categories: collision and contact safety, grasp stability, release stability, cross-contamination, action onset, mechanism recovery, object containment, and enclosure access. Templates can be instantiated with task-specific objects, fixtures, regions, or skills, allowing the same safety specifications to generalize across tasks and environments. We evaluate SafeManip on six vision-language-action policies, including $π_0$, $π_{0.5}$, GR00T, and their training variants, across 50 RoboCasa365 household tasks. Results show that even strong models often behave unsafely. Task-success gains do not reliably translate into safer execution: many successful rollouts remain unsafe, while longer-horizon or more complex tasks expose more violations. SafeManip provides a reusable evaluation layer for diagnosing temporal safety failures and measuring safe success beyond task completion.
tldr: The paper introduces SafeManip, a property-driven benchmark for evaluating temporal safety in robotic manipulation using Linear Temporal Logic over finite traces, and demonstrates its use by testing various vision-language-action policies on household tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了SafeManip，一个基于属性驱动的基准测试，用于使用有限轨迹上的线性时序逻辑评估机器人操作中的时序安全性，并通过在家庭任务上测试各种视觉-语言-动作策略来展示其应用。
summary_zh: 机器人操作的评估通常以任务成功率为标准，但成功完成并不保证执行过程的安全性。许多安全故障具有时序性：例如机器人可能在污染后接触清洁表面，或在物体未完全进入封闭空间时就提前释放。本研究提出SafeManip——一种基于属性驱动的基准框架，旨在明确评估机器人操作中的时序安全属性，突破以往主要关注任务完成度或单状态约束违反的评估范式。SafeManip基于有限轨迹线性时序逻辑（LTLf）在有限执行轨迹上定义可复用的安全模板，将观测到的操作轨迹映射为符号谓词序列，并通过LTLf监控器进行评估。其属性集涵盖八类操作安全范畴：碰撞与接触安全、抓取稳定性、释放稳定性、交叉污染、动作启动时机、机构复位、物体包容性及封闭空间进出权限。这些模板可通过任务特定的物体、固定装置、区域或技能进行实例化，使同一套安全规范能跨任务与环境泛化。我们在50项RoboCasa365家庭任务中，对包括$π_0$、$π_{0.5}$、GR00T及其训练变体在内的六种视觉-语言-动作策略进行评估。结果表明，即使强模型也常出现不安全行为：任务成功率的提升并不能可靠转化为更安全的执行过程——许多成功轨迹仍存在安全隐患，而更长期或更复杂的任务会暴露更多安全违规。SafeManip为诊断时序安全故障及衡量超越任务完成度的安全成功率，提供了一个可复用的评估层级。

title: GuidedVLA: Specifying Task-Relevant Factors via Plug-and-Play Action Attention Specialization
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models aim for general robot learning by aligning action as a modality within powerful Vision-Language Models (VLMs). Existing VLAs rely on end-to-end supervision to implicitly enable the action decoding process to learn task-relevant features. However, without explicit guidance, these models often overfit to spurious correlations, such as visual shortcuts or environmental noise, limiting their generalization. In this paper, we introduce GuidedVLA, a framework designed to manually guide the action generation to focus on task-relevant factors. Our core insight is to treat the action decoder not as a monolithic learner, but as an assembly of functional components. Individual attention heads are supervised by manually defined auxiliary signals to capture distinct factors. As an initial study, we instantiate this paradigm with three specialized heads: object grounding, spatial geometry, and temporal skill logic. Across simulation and real-robot experiments, GuidedVLA improves success rates in both in-domain and out-of-domain settings compared to strong VLA baselines. Finally, we show that the quality of these specialized factors correlates positively with task performance and that our mechanism yields decoupled, high-quality features. Our results suggest that explicitly guiding action-decoder learning is a promising direction for building more robust and general VLA models.
tldr: The paper proposes GuidedVLA, a framework that explicitly guides the action decoder of Vision-Language-Action models by supervising individual attention heads with manually defined auxiliary signals for factors like object grounding, improving robustness and generalization in robotic tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出GuidedVLA框架，通过用手动定义的辅助信号监督特定注意力头来明确引导VLA模型的动作解码器关注任务相关因素，提高了机器人任务中的鲁棒性和泛化性。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型旨在通过将动作作为模态与强大的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）对齐，实现通用机器人学习。现有VLA模型依赖端到端监督来隐式驱动动作解码过程学习任务相关特征。然而，由于缺乏显式引导，这些模型常会过度拟合伪相关性（如视觉捷径或环境噪声），限制了其泛化能力。本文提出引导式VLA框架（GuidedVLA），通过人工引导动作生成过程聚焦于任务相关因素。我们的核心见解是将动作解码器视为功能组件的集合而非单一学习器，通过人工定义的辅助信号监督各独立注意力头以捕获不同特征维度。作为初步研究，我们通过三个专用头实例化该范式：物体定位、空间几何与时间技能逻辑。在仿真与真实机器人实验中，与现有VLA基线相比，GuidedVLA在域内和域外场景下均提升了任务成功率。实验进一步表明，这些专用特征的质量与任务性能呈正相关，且我们的机制能够产生解耦的高质量特征。研究结果表明，显式引导动作解码器学习是构建更鲁棒、更通用的VLA模型的有效方向。

title: SI-Diff: A Framework for Learning Search and High-Precision Insertion with a Force-Domain Diffusion Policy
summary: Contact-rich assembly is fundamental in robotics but poses significant challenges due to uncertainties in relative poses, such as misalignments and small clearances in peg-in-hole tasks. Existing approaches typically address search and high-precision insertion separately, because these tasks involve distinct action patterns. However, supporting both tasks within a single model, without switching models or weights, is desirable for intelligent assembly systems. In this work, we propose SI-Diff, a framework that learns both search and high-precision insertion through a force-domain diffusion policy. To this end, we introduce a new mode-conditioning mechanism that enables the policy to capture distinct action behaviors under a single framework. Moreover, we develop a new search teacher policy that can generate diverse trajectories. By training on successful and efficient demonstrations provided by the teacher policy, the model learns the mapping from tactile and end-effector velocity observations to effective action behaviors. We conduct thorough experiments to show that SI-Diff extends the tolerance to x-y misalignments from 2 mm to 5 mm compared to the state-of-the-art baseline, TacDiffusion, while also demonstrating strong zero-shot transferability to unseen shapes.
tldr: Proposes SI-Diff, a force-domain diffusion policy with mode conditioning to unify search and high-precision insertion in contact-rich assembly tasks, improving misalignment tolerance and zero-shot shape transfer.
tldr_zh: 提出了SI-Diff，一种带有模式条件机制的力域扩散策略框架，用于统一学习搜索和高精度插入，提高了接触式装配任务的位姿容错性和零样本形状泛化能力。
summary_zh: 富含接触的装配任务是机器人技术的基础，但由于相对位姿的不确定性，如轴孔装配中的错位和微小间隙，它带来了显著挑战。现有方法通常分别处理搜索和高精度插入任务，因为这些任务涉及不同的动作模式。然而，对于智能装配系统而言，无需切换模型或权重即可在单一模型中同时支持这两类任务是理想目标。本研究提出SI-Diff框架，该框架通过力域扩散策略同时学习搜索和高精度插入操作。为此，我们引入一种新的模式条件机制，使策略能够在单一框架下捕捉不同的动作行为。此外，我们开发了一种能够生成多样化轨迹的搜索教师策略。通过在教师策略提供的成功且高效的示范数据上进行训练，该模型学会了从触觉感知和末端执行器速度观测到有效动作行为的映射。我们通过系统实验表明，相比当前最先进的基线方法TacDiffusion，SI-Diff将x-y方向错位容忍度从2毫米提升至5毫米，同时对未见形状展现出强大的零样本迁移能力。

title: TMRL: Diffusion Timestep-Modulated Pretraining Enables Exploration for Efficient Policy Finetuning
summary: Fine-tuning pre-trained robot policies with reinforcement learning (RL) often inherits the bottlenecks introduced by pre-training with behavioral cloning (BC), which produces narrow action distributions that lack the coverage necessary for downstream exploration. We present a unified framework that enables the exploration necessary to enable efficient robot policy finetuning by bridging BC pre-training and RL fine-tuning. Our pre-training method, Context-Smoothed Pre-training (CSP), injects forward-diffusion noise into policy inputs, creating a continuum between precise imitation and broad action coverage. We then fine-tune pre-trained policies via Timestep-Modulated Reinforcement Learning (TMRL), which trains the agent to dynamically adjust this conditioning during fine-tuning by modulating the diffusion timestep, granting explicit control over exploration. Integrating seamlessly with arbitrary policy inputs, e.g., states, 3D point clouds, or image-based VLA policies, we show that TMRL improves RL fine-tuning sample efficiency. Notably, TMRL enables successful real-world fine-tuning on complex manipulation tasks in under one hour. Videos and code available at https://weirdlabuw.github.io/tmrl/.
tldr: Proposes a unified framework for robot policy learning that bridges BC pre-training and RL fine-tuning via diffusion timestep modulation, enabling efficient exploration and successful real-world manipulation fine-tuning in under an hour.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种通过扩散时间步长调制桥接BC预训练和RL微调的机器人策略学习统一框架，实现了高效的探索，并成功在不到一小时内完成真实世界复杂操作任务的微调。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
通过强化学习对预训练机器人策略进行微调，往往继承了行为克隆预训练带来的瓶颈——后者生成的动作分布范围狭窄，缺乏下游探索所需的覆盖度。本文提出一种统一框架，通过桥接行为克隆预训练与强化学习微调，为高效机器人策略微调提供必要的探索能力。我们的预训练方法“上下文平滑预训练”将前向扩散噪声注入策略输入，在精确模仿与广泛动作覆盖之间建立连续过渡。随后，我们通过“时序调制强化学习”对预训练策略进行微调，该方法训练智能体在微调过程中动态调节扩散时间步以调整条件参数，从而实现对探索行为的显式控制。该方法可与任意策略输入（如状态、三维点云或基于图像的视觉语言动作策略）无缝集成，实验表明时序调制强化学习能显著提升强化学习微调的样本效率。值得注意的是，该方法能在不足一小时内成功完成复杂操作任务在现实世界中的微调。视频与代码详见：https://weirdlabuw.github.io/tmrl/。

title: Morphologically Equivariant Flow Matching for Bimanual Mobile Manipulation
summary: Mobile manipulation requires coordinated control of high-dimensional, bimanual robots. Imitation learning methods have been broadly used to solve these robotic tasks, yet typically ignore the bilateral morphological symmetry inherent in such systems. We argue that morphological symmetry is an underexplored but crucial inductive bias for learning in bimanual mobile manipulation: knowing how to solve a task in one configuration directly determines how to solve its mirrored counterpart. In this paper, we formalize this symmetry prior and show that it constrains optimal bimanual policies to be ambidextrous and equivariant under reflections across the robot's sagittal plane. We introduce a $\mathbb{C}_2$-equivariant flow matching policy that enforces reflective symmetry either via a regularized training loss or an equivariant velocity network. Across planar and 6-DoF mobile manipulation tasks, symmetry-informed policies consistently improve sample efficiency and achieve zero-shot generalization to mirrored configurations absent from the training distribution. We further validate this zero-shot generalization capability on a real-world manipulation task with a TIAGo++ robot. Together, our findings establish morphological symmetry as an effective, generalizable, and scalable inductive bias for ambidextrous generative policy learning.
tldr: This paper introduces a morphologically equivariant flow matching policy that enforces reflective symmetry for bimanual mobile manipulation, improving sample efficiency and enabling zero-shot generalization to mirrored configurations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种形态等变的流匹配策略，用于双手机器人移动操作，通过强制执行反射对称性来提高样本效率并实现零样本泛化到未训练过的镜像配置。
summary_zh: 移动操作要求对高维度、双手机器人进行协调控制。模仿学习方法已被广泛用于解决这些机器人任务，但通常忽视了此类系统固有的双边形态对称性。我们认为形态对称性是一种尚未被充分探索但至关重要的归纳偏置，对于双手机器人移动操作的学习至关重要：了解如何在一种配置下完成任务，可以直接确定如何完成其镜像对应任务。本文形式化了这种对称性先验，并证明其将最优双手操作策略约束为两侧对称，且在机器人矢状面反射变换下具有等变性。我们引入了一种$\mathbb{C}_2$-等变性流匹配策略，通过正则化训练损失或等变性速度网络来强制反射对称性。在平面和六自由度移动操作任务中，融入对称性信息的策略持续提升了样本效率，并实现了对训练分布中不存在的镜像配置的零样本泛化能力。我们进一步在真实世界的TIAGo++机器人操作任务中验证了这种零样本泛化能力。综上，我们的研究确立了形态对称性作为一种有效、可泛化且可扩展的归纳偏置，适用于两侧对称的生成式策略学习。

title: X-Imitator: Spatial-Aware Imitation Learning via Bidirectional Action-Pose Interaction
summary: Effectively handling the interplay between spatial perception and action generation remains a critical bottleneck in robotic manipulation. Existing methods typically treat spatial perception and action execution as decoupled or strictly unidirectional processes, fundamentally restricting a robot's ability to master complex manipulation tasks. To address this, we propose X-Imitator, a versatile dual-path framework that models spatial perception and action execution as a tightly coupled bidirectional loop. By reciprocally conditioning current pose predictions on past actions and vice versa, this framework enables continuous mutual refinement between spatial reasoning and action generation. This joint modeling exactly mimics human internal forward models. Designed as a modular architecture, the system can be seamlessly integrated into various visuomotor policies. Extensive experiments across 24 simulated and 3 real-world tasks demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms both vanilla policies and prior methods utilizing explicit pose guidance. The code will be open sourced.
tldr: Proposes a dual-path imitation learning framework for robotic manipulation that bidirectionally couples spatial perception (pose prediction) and action generation, enabling continuous mutual refinement.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于机器人模仿学习的双路径框架，通过双向交互将空间感知与动作生成紧密耦合，实现持续相互优化。
summary_zh: 有效处理空间感知与动作生成之间的相互作用仍然是机器人操控中的关键瓶颈。现有方法通常将空间感知与动作执行视为解耦或严格单向的流程，这从根本上限制了机器人掌握复杂操控任务的能力。为此，我们提出X-Imitator，一种通用的双路径框架，将空间感知与动作执行建模为紧密耦合的双向循环。通过在过去动作上递归地调节当前位姿预测，并反之亦然，该框架实现了空间推理与动作生成之间的持续互优化。这种联合建模方式精确模拟了人类内部的前向预测模型。该系统采用模块化架构设计，可无缝集成到各类视觉运动策略中。在24项模拟任务和3项真实世界任务中的大量实验表明，我们的框架显著优于原始策略及现有采用显式位姿引导的方法。代码将开源发布。

title: Premover: Fast Vision-Language-Action Control by Acting Before Instructions Are Complete
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are typically evaluated as if the user had finished typing or speaking before the robot begins acting. In real deployment, however, users take several seconds to enter a request, leaving the policy idle for a substantial fraction of the interaction. We introduce Premover, a lightweight module that converts this idle window into useful precomputation. Premover keeps the VLA backbone frozen and attaches two small projection heads, one for image patches, one for language tokens, that map an intermediate layer of the backbone into a shared space. The resulting focus map is supervised by simulator-rendered target-object segmentation masks and applied as a per-patch reweighting of the next step's image tokens. A single scalar readiness threshold, trained jointly from streaming prefixes, decides when the policy should begin acting. On the LIBERO benchmark suite, Premover reduces mean wall-clock time from 34.0 to 29.4 seconds, a 13.6% reduction, while matching the full-prompt baseline's success rate (95.1% vs. 95.0%); naive premoving, by contrast, collapses to 66.4%.
tldr: Premover reduces interaction latency in VLA policies by allowing the robot to start acting before user instructions are complete, using lightweight projection heads and a readiness threshold to convert idle time into precomputation.
tldr_zh: Premover通过轻量级投影头和一个就绪阈值，让机器人在用户指令输入完成前开始行动，将空闲时间转换为预计算，从而降低VLA策略的交互延迟。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在评估时通常假设用户在机器人开始行动前已完成指令输入。然而，在实际部署中，用户需要数秒时间输入请求，这导致策略在交互过程中存在大量空闲窗口。本文提出Premover模块，通过轻量级架构将空闲窗口转化为有效预计算。该模块保持VLA主干网络冻结，仅附加两个小型投影头——分别对应图像块与语言标记，将主干网络的中间层映射至共享空间。生成的重点注意力图通过模拟器渲染的目标物体分割掩码进行监督，并作为下一步图像标记的逐块重加权依据。通过联合训练流式指令前缀，系统学习单一标量就绪阈值，以决定策略何时开始行动。在LIBERO基准测试中，Premover将平均耗时从34.0秒降至29.4秒（减少13.6%），同时保持与完整指令基线相当的成功率（95.1%对比95.0%）；相比之下，简单预执行方案的成功率会骤降至66.4%。

title: World Action Models: The Next Frontier in Embodied AI
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved strong semantic generalization for embodied policy learning, yet they learn reactive observation-to-action mappings without explicitly modeling how the physical world evolves under intervention. A growing body of work addresses this limitation by integrating world models, predictive models of environment dynamics, into the action generation pipeline. We term this emerging paradigm World Action Models (WAMs): embodied foundation models that unify predictive state modeling with action generation, targeting a joint distribution over future states and actions rather than actions alone. However, the literature remains fragmented across architectures, learning objectives, and application scenarios, lacking a unified conceptual framework. We formally define WAMs and disambiguate them from related concepts, and trace the foundations and early integration of VLA and world model research that gave rise to this paradigm. We organize existing methods into a structured taxonomy of Cascaded and Joint WAMs, with further subdivision by generation modality, conditioning mechanism, and action decoding strategy. We systematically analyze the data ecosystem fueling WAMs development, spanning robot teleoperation, portable human demonstrations, simulation, and internet-scale egocentric video, and synthesize emerging evaluation protocols organized around visual fidelity, physical commonsense, and action plausibility. Overall, this survey provides the first systematic account of the WAMs landscape, clarifies key architectural paradigms and their trade-offs, and identifies open challenges and future opportunities for this rapidly evolving field.
tldr: This survey paper proposes a unified conceptual framework for World Action Models (WAMs), which integrate predictive world models with action generation for embodied AI, and provides a structured taxonomy of existing methods.
tldr_zh: 本综述论文提出了一个用于具身AI的世界行动模型（WAMs）的统一概念框架，该框架将预测性世界模型与行动生成相结合，并对现有方法进行了结构化分类。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型在具身策略学习领域已展现出强大的语义泛化能力，但这类模型仅学习从观察到动作的被动映射，并未显式建模物理世界在干预下的演化过程。近期研究通过将世界模型（即环境动态的预测模型）整合到动作生成流程中，以应对这一局限。我们将这一新兴范式称为世界动作模型：这是一种将预测性状态建模与动作生成相统一的具身基础模型，其目标是联合建模未来状态与动作的分布，而非仅关注动作。然而，现有研究在架构、学习目标与应用场景上仍较为分散，缺乏统一的概念框架。本文正式定义了世界动作模型，并厘清了其与相关概念的边界，同时追溯了催生该范式的视觉-语言-动作模型与世界模型研究的基础及早期融合路径。我们将现有方法归纳为级联式与联合式世界动作模型的结构化分类体系，并依据生成模态、条件机制和动作解码策略进行细分。系统分析了推动世界动作模型发展的数据生态系统，涵盖机器人遥操作、便携式人类示教、仿真以及互联网规模的第一人称视频，并综合梳理了围绕视觉保真度、物理常识与动作合理性构建的新兴评估体系。总体而言，本综述首次系统阐述了世界动作模型的研究图景，明晰了关键架构范式及其权衡，并为这一快速演进领域指出了开放挑战与未来机遇。

title: From Reaction to Anticipation: Proactive Failure Recovery through Agentic Task Graph for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Although robotic manipulation has made significant progress, reliable execution remains challenging because task failures are inevitable in dynamic and unstructured environments. To handle such failures, existing frameworks typically follow a stepwise detect-reason-recover pipeline, which often incurs high latency and limited robustness due to delayed reasoning and reactive planning. Inspired by the human capability to anticipate and proactively plan for potential failures, we introduce AgentChord, an agentic system that models a manipulation task as a directed task graph. Before execution, this graph is enriched with anticipatory recovery branches that specify context-aware corrective behaviors, enabling immediate and targeted responses when failures occur. Specifically, AgentChord operates through a choreography of specialized agents: a composer that structures the nominal task graph, an arranger that augments the graph with anticipatory recovery branches, and a conductor that compiles and coordinates executable transitions using low-latency monitors to detect deviations and trigger pre-compiled recoveries without re-planning. Empirical studies on diverse long-horizon bimanual manipulation tasks demonstrate that AgentChord substantially improves success rates and execution efficiency, advancing the reliability and autonomy of real-world robotic systems. The project page is available at: https://shengxu.net/AgentChord/.
tldr: AgentChord introduces an agentic task-graph system for robotic manipulation that proactively augments nominal task graphs with anticipatory recovery branches, enabling low-latency failure recovery without re-planning.
tldr_zh: AgentChord 提出了一种用于机器人操作的智能任务图系统，通过在名义任务图中主动添加预测性恢复分支，实现无需重新规划的低延迟故障恢复。
summary_zh: 尽管机器人操作技术已取得显著进步，但在动态非结构化环境中，任务失败仍不可避免，实现可靠执行依然面临挑战。为应对此类故障，现有框架通常遵循“检测-推理-恢复”的逐步处理流程，但受限于推理延迟与反应式规划，往往存在高延迟和鲁棒性不足的问题。受人类预见潜在故障并主动规划能力的启发，我们提出AgentChord系统——该系统将操作任务建模为有向任务图，在执行前通过预置具有情境感知能力的恢复分支来规划针对性矫正行为，从而在故障发生时实现即时精准响应。具体而言，AgentChord通过多智能体协同框架运行：编排器负责构建标准任务图，规划器为任务图添加预见性恢复分支，指挥器则利用低延迟监控器编译协调可执行的状态转换，在检测到偏差时无需重新规划即可触发预编译的恢复程序。在多类长时序双手操作任务上的实证研究表明，AgentChord能显著提升任务成功率与执行效率，推动现实世界机器人系统朝着更高可靠性与自主性迈进。项目页面详见：https://shengxu.net/AgentChord/。

title: Learning Action Manifold with Multi-view Latent Priors for Robotic Manipulation
summary: This paper tackles spatial perception and manipulation challenges in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. To address depth ambiguity from monocular input, we leverage a pre-trained multi-view diffusion model to synthesize latent novel views and propose a Geometry-Guided Gated Transformer (G3T) that aligns multi-view features under 3D geometric guidance while adaptively filtering occlusion noise. To improve action learning efficiency, we introduce Action Manifold Learning (AML), which directly predicts actions on the valid action manifold, bypassing inefficient regression of unstructured targets like noise or velocity. Experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-robot tasks show our method achieves superior success rate and robustness over SOTA baselines. Project page: https://junjxiao.github.io/Multi-view-VLA.github.io/.
tldr: This paper addresses spatial perception and action learning in VLA models for robotics by using a multi-view diffusion model for novel view synthesis and a Geometry-Guided Gated Transformer to fuse features, and introduces Action Manifold Learning to improve action prediction efficiency.
tldr_zh: 该论文通过使用多视角扩散模型进行新颖视图合成和几何引导的门控变换器融合特征，解决VLA模型中的空间感知问题，并引入动作流形学习以提高机器人操作中的动作预测效率。
summary_zh: 本文针对视觉-语言-动作模型在空间感知与操作方面存在的挑战展开研究。为解决单目输入带来的深度模糊问题，我们利用预训练的多视角扩散模型合成潜在的新视角图像，并提出一种几何引导门控Transformer模块。该模块在三维几何约束下对齐多视角特征，同时自适应过滤遮挡噪声。为提升动作学习效率，我们提出动作流形学习方法，通过在有效动作流形上直接预测动作，避免了传统方法对噪声或速度等非结构化目标进行低效回归的问题。在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0仿真环境及真实机器人任务上的实验表明，本方法相较于当前最优基线模型在成功率和鲁棒性方面均有显著提升。项目主页：https://junjxiao.github.io/Multi-view-VLA.github.io/。

title: DreamAvoid: Critical-Phase Test-Time Dreaming to Avoid Failures in VLA Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are often brittle in fine-grained manipulation, where minor action errors during the critical phases can rapidly escalate into irrecoverable failures. Since existing VLA models rely predominantly on successful demonstrations for training, they lack an explicit awareness of failure during these critical phases. To address this, we propose DreamAvoid, a critical-phase test-time dreaming framework that enables VLA models to anticipate and avoid failures. We also introduce an autonomous boundary learning paradigm to refine the system's understanding of the subtle boundary between success and failure. Specifically, we (1) utilize a Dream Trigger to determine whether the execution has entered a critical phase, (2) sample multiple candidate action chunks from the VLA via an Action Proposer, and (3) employ a Dream Evaluator, jointly trained on mixed data (success, failure, and boundary cases), to "dream" the short-horizon futures corresponding to the candidate actions, evaluate their values, and select the optimal action. We conduct extensive evaluations on real-world manipulation tasks and simulation benchmarks. The results demonstrate that DreamAvoid can effectively avoid failures, thereby improving the overall task success rate. Our code is available at https://github.com/XianzheFan/DreamAvoid.
tldr: DreamAvoid uses test-time dreaming to anticipate and avoid failures in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies during critical phases of manipulation, improving task success rates.
tldr_zh: DreamAvoid 提出了一种关键阶段测试时“做梦”框架，使VLA模型能够预测和避免操作失败，从而提高任务成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在精细操作任务中往往表现脆弱，关键阶段微小的动作误差可能迅速导致不可挽回的失败。由于现有VLA模型主要依赖成功演示进行训练，它们缺乏对这些关键阶段失败的显式认知。为此，我们提出DreamAvoid——一种关键阶段测试时"推演"框架，使VLA模型能够预测并规避失败。我们还引入了一种自主边界学习范式，以提升系统对成功与失败之间微妙边界的理解能力。具体而言，我们（1）通过"梦境触发器"判断执行是否进入关键阶段，（2）通过"动作提议器"从VLA模型中采样多个候选动作序列，（3）采用在混合数据（成功、失败及边界案例）上联合训练的"梦境评估器"，对候选动作对应的短期未来进行"推演"，评估其价值并选择最优动作。我们在真实世界操作任务与仿真基准测试中进行了广泛评估。结果表明，DreamAvoid能有效规避失败，从而提升整体任务成功率。项目代码已开源：https://github.com/XianzheFan/DreamAvoid。

title: Rainbow Deep Q-Learning with Kinematics-Aware Design for Cooperative Delta and 3-RRS Parallel Robot Insertion
summary: This paper presents a kinematics-aware deep reinforcement learning framework based on Rainbow Deep Q-Networks (DQN) for cooperative peg-in-hole manipulation by a Delta parallel robot and a 3-RRS (Revolute--Revolute--Spherical) parallel manipulator. A key contribution is the integration of a geometric design-optimization stage that precedes learning: the 3-RRS geometry is tuned to maximize the singularity-free workspace and improve conditioning, which in turn enlarges the safe region in which the reinforcement learning policy can explore. Together the two manipulators expose a 6~degree-of-freedom (DoF) controllable subspace (three Delta translations, two 3-RRS rotations, and one 3-RRS vertical translation); the peg-in-hole task is invariant to rotation about the peg axis, so the task-relevant manifold is five dimensional. The cooperative insertion problem is cast as a Markov Decision Process with a 12-dimensional state vector and a discrete action set containing $6 \times 2 = 12$ incremental commands (one positive and one negative per controlled DoF). A shaped reward combines dense proximity guidance, penalties for kinematic and workspace violations, and sparse bonuses for successful insertions. The Rainbow DQN -- integrating double Q-learning, dueling architecture, prioritized replay, multi-step returns, noisy linear layers for exploration, and a distributional value head -- is trained with a two-stage curriculum. The co-designed framework is validated in a high-fidelity kinematic simulator, where it achieves stable policy convergence, reliable insertions, and reduced constraint violations compared against a vanilla DQN agent and a classical sampling-based planner.
tldr: This paper proposes a kinematics-aware Rainbow DQN framework for cooperative peg-in-hole manipulation, where a geometric design optimization of a parallel manipulator precedes RL training to improve exploration safety and policy performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于协同销孔插入的、具有运动学感知的 Rainbow DQN 框架，其中对并联机器人的几何设计优化先于强化学习训练，以提高探索安全性和策略性能。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于彩虹深度Q网络（DQN）的运动学感知深度强化学习框架，用于Delta并联机器人和3-RRS（旋转-旋转-球关节）并联机械臂的协同轴孔装配任务。核心贡献在于引入了一个先于学习阶段的几何设计优化环节：通过调整3-RRS机械臂的几何参数，以最大化无奇异工作空间并优化条件数，从而扩展强化学习策略可安全探索的区域。两台机械臂协同形成一个6自由度可控子空间（Delta机构提供三个平移自由度，3-RRS机构提供两个旋转自由度及一个垂直平移自由度）；由于轴孔装配任务对绕轴旋转具有不变性，任务相关的流形维度为五维。协同插入问题被建模为马尔可夫决策过程，其状态向量为12维，离散动作集包含$6 \times 2 = 12$个增量控制指令（每个受控自由度对应正负两个方向）。设计的奖励函数融合了密集距离引导、运动学与工作空间违规惩罚，以及成功插入的稀疏奖励。采用集成双Q学习、竞争架构、优先经验回放、多步回报、带噪声线性探索层及分布式价值头等技术的彩虹DQN算法，通过两阶段课程进行训练。该协同设计框架在高精度运动学仿真环境中得到验证，相比原始DQN智能体与经典基于采样的规划器，本方法实现了更稳定的策略收敛、更高的装配成功率及更低的约束违规率。

title: RIO: Flexible Real-Time Robot I/O for Cross-Embodiment Robot Learning
summary: Despite recent efforts to collect multi-task, multi-embodiment datasets, to design recipes for training Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs), and to showcase these models on different robot platforms, generalist cross-embodiment robot capabilities remains a largely elusive ideal. Progress is limited by fragmented infrastructure: most robot code is highly specific to the exact setup the user decided on, which adds major overhead when attempting to reuse, recycle, or share artifacts between users. We present RIO (Robot I/O), an open source Python framework that provides flexible, lightweight components for robot control, teleoperation, data formatting, sensor configuration, and policy deployment across diverse hardware platforms and morphologies. RIO provides abstractions that enable users to make any choice and to switch between them, with minimal reconfiguration effort. We validate RIO on VLA deployment workflows across three morphologies (single-arm, bimanual, humanoid) and four hardware platforms with varying grippers and cameras. Using teleoperated data collected with RIO, we fine-tune state-of-the-art VLAs including $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T on household tasks such as pick-and-place, folding, and bowl scrubbing. By open sourcing all our efforts, we hope the community can accelerate their pace of robot learning on real-world robot hardware. Additional details at: https://robot-i-o.github.io
tldr: RIO is a flexible, open-source robot I/O framework for cross-embodiment robot learning, enabling efficient control, teleoperation, data formatting, and VLA policy deployment across diverse hardware platforms.
tldr_zh: RIO是一个灵活的开源机器人I/O框架，用于跨具身机器人学习，可在多样化硬件平台上实现高效的控制、遥操作、数据格式化以及VLA策略部署。
summary_zh: 尽管近期在收集多任务、多形态机器人数据集、设计视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）训练方案，以及在不同机器人平台上展示这些模型方面已付出诸多努力，但通用化的跨形态机器人能力仍远未实现理想状态。进展受限的主要原因在于基础设施碎片化：大多数机器人代码高度依赖用户选定的特定硬件配置，这导致在用户间尝试复用、重构或共享技术成果时产生巨大额外成本。我们推出RIO（Robot I/O）——一个开源的Python框架，它提供灵活、轻量级的组件，支持跨异构硬件平台与形态结构的机器人控制、遥操作、数据格式化、传感器配置及策略部署。RIO通过抽象层设计，使用户能够自由选择各类组件并实现低配置成本的快速切换。我们在三种形态结构（单臂、双臂、人形）和四种搭载不同抓取器与摄像头的硬件平台上，通过VLA部署流程验证了RIO的实用性。利用RIO采集的遥操作数据，我们对包括$π_{0.5}$和GR00T在内的前沿VLA模型进行微调，成功应用于拾取放置、折叠衣物、刷洗碗盆等家庭任务。通过开源全部成果，我们期待能助力研究社区加速在真实机器人硬件上的学习进程。更多细节请访问：https://robot-i-o.github.io

title: RankQ: Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning via Self-Supervised Action Ranking
summary: Offline-to-online reinforcement learning (RL) improves sample efficiency by leveraging pre-collected datasets prior to online interaction. A key challenge, however, is learning an accurate critic in large state--action spaces with limited dataset coverage. To mitigate harmful updates from value overestimation, prior methods impose pessimism by down-weighting out-of-distribution (OOD) actions relative to dataset actions. While effective, this essentially acts as a behavior cloning anchor and can hinder downstream online policy improvement when dataset actions are suboptimal. We propose RankQ, an offline-to-online Q-learning objective that augments temporal-difference learning with a self-supervised multi-term ranking loss to enforce structured action ordering. By learning relative action preferences rather than uniformly penalizing unseen actions, RankQ shapes the Q-function such that action gradients are directed toward higher-quality behaviors. Across sparse reward D4RL benchmarks, RankQ achieves performance competitive with or superior to seven prior methods. In vision-based robot learning, RankQ enables effective offline-to-online fine-tuning of a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) model in a low-data regime, achieving on average a 42.7% higher simulation success rate than the next best method. In a high-data setting, RankQ improves simulation performance by 13.7% over the next best method and achieves strong sim-to-real transfer, increasing real-world cube stacking success from 43.1% to 84.7% relative to the VLA's initial performance.
tldr: The paper proposes RankQ, an offline-to-online reinforcement learning method using a self-supervised action ranking loss to improve critic learning and enable effective policy fine-tuning, including for a vision-language-action model in robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出RankQ，一种通过自监督动作排序损失改进离线到在线强化学习的方法，提升Q函数学习，并能有效微调视觉-语言-动作模型，用于机器人操作。
summary_zh: 摘要：离线到在线强化学习通过利用在线交互前预收集的数据集来提升样本效率。然而，其核心挑战在于如何在有限数据集覆盖的大规模状态-动作空间中学习到精确的评判器。为缓解值函数高估带来的有害更新，现有方法通过降低分布外动作相对于数据集动作的权重来施加悲观约束。尽管有效，但这种方法本质上充当了行为克隆锚点，在数据集动作非最优时可能阻碍后续在线策略的改进。本文提出RankQ算法，这是一种离线到在线Q学习目标，通过引入自监督多级排序损失来增强时序差分学习，从而构建结构化动作排序机制。RankQ通过学习相对动作偏好而非均匀惩罚未见动作，对Q函数进行塑造，使得动作梯度指向更高质量的行为。在稀疏奖励的D4RL基准测试中，RankQ取得了与先前七种方法相当或更优的性能。在基于视觉的机器人学习中，RankQ能够在低数据条件下对预训练的视觉-语言-动作模型进行有效的离线到在线微调，在仿真任务中平均成功率较次优方法提升42.7%。在高数据设定下，RankQ将仿真性能提升13.7%，并实现了显著的仿真到现实迁移，使现实世界积木堆叠任务的成功率从初始的43.1%提升至84.7%。

title: Forecast-aware Gaussian Splatting for Predictive 3D Representation in Language-Guided Pick-and-Place Manipulation
summary:
We introduce Forecast-aware Gaussian Splatting (Forecast-GS), a predictive 3D representation framework for language-conditioned robotic manipulation. While recent manipulation systems have made progress by grounding language instructions into robot affordances, value maps, or relational keypoint constraints, they usually reason over the current scene and do not explicitly model the task-completed state. This limitation is critical when success depends on satisfying spatial and semantic goals under partial observations, where the robot must evaluate whether a candidate action leads to a feasible task-consistent outcome.
  We validate Forecast-GS on real-world pick-and-place manipulation tasks, including Cutter-to-Box, Apple-to-Bowl, and Sponge-to-Tray. For each task, we conduct 25 real-world trials under varied initial object configurations using the same robot platform and sensing setup. Forecast-GS with automatic candidate selection achieves success rates of 21/25, 23/25, and 16/25 on the three tasks, respectively, outperforming the ReKep baseline, which achieves 15/25, 19/25, and 10/25. A diagnostic human-assisted setting further improves success rates to 23/25, 24/25, and 19/25, suggesting that candidate generation is effective while automatic ranking remains imperfect. These results suggest that explicitly forecasting task-completed 3D states enables more reliable action evaluation, while the gap between automatic and human-assisted selection indicates that robust final-state ranking remains an important challenge for fully autonomous manipulation. Overall, Forecast-GS provides an interpretable bridge between language understanding, 3D perception, and robotic manipulation planning.
tldr: The paper introduces Forecast-aware Gaussian Splatting, a predictive 3D representation framework for evaluating candidate actions in language-conditioned pick-and-place manipulation by explicitly modeling task-completed states.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了用于预测的3D感知高斯泼溅框架，通过显式建模任务完成状态，在语言引导的抓放操作中评估候选动作。
summary_zh:
本文提出了预测感知高斯泼溅（Forecast-GS）框架，这是一种面向语言条件机器人操作的预测性三维表示方法。尽管近期机器人操作系统通过将语言指令映射到机器人功能、价值图谱或关联关键点约束方面取得进展，但现有系统通常仅基于当前场景进行推理，未显式建模任务完成状态。这一局限在部分观测条件下尤为突出——当任务成功取决于满足空间与语义目标时，机器人必须评估候选动作是否能产生符合任务要求的可行结果。

我们在现实世界拾放操作任务中验证了Forecast-GS框架，包括刀具入盒、苹果入碗和海绵入盘三项任务。每个任务均采用相同机器人平台与传感配置，在25种不同初始物体摆放条件下进行实测。配备自动候选动作选择的Forecast-GS在三项任务中分别取得21/25、23/25和16/25的成功率，优于ReKep基线方法的15/25、19/25和10/25。在诊断性人工辅助设置下，成功率进一步提升至23/25、24/25和19/25，表明候选动作生成机制有效，但自动排序环节仍存在优化空间。这些结果证明，显式预测任务完成状态的三维场景能实现更可靠的动作评估，而自动与人工辅助选择之间的性能差距表明，鲁棒的终态排序机制仍是实现全自主操作的关键挑战。总体而言，Forecast-GS在语言理解、三维感知与机器人操作规划之间构建了可解释的桥梁。

title: SEVO: Semantic-Enhanced Virtual Observation for Robust VLA Manipulation via Active Illumination and Data-Centric Collection
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and imitation-learning policies trained via community toolchains on low-cost hardware frequently fail when deployed outside the training environment. Existing evaluations, including the original ACT and SmolVLA benchmarks, demonstrate high success rates under controlled, fixed backgrounds, yet community practitioners report near-zero transfer to new environments. We present SEVO (Semantic-Enhanced Virtual Observation), a data-centric approach that improves cross-environment manipulation robustness without modifying the policy architecture. SEVO transforms the raw RGB camera stream through three mechanisms: (1) body-fixed cameras whose combined fields of view cover the full manipulation workspace, (2) active red-spectrum illumination that physically normalizes object appearance, and (3) real-time YOLO segmentation overlay that provides a background-invariant semantic cue. Critically, we show that a diversified data collection protocol (systematically varying lighting, backgrounds, and distractors during teleoperation) is the single most important factor for generalization. We target transparent water bottles, objects that visually blend with their surroundings, and select a simple pick-and-place task to enable hundreds of controlled real-robot trials across two mobile platforms. The full pipeline achieves 95% grasp success with ACT and 83% with SmolVLA in the training environment, transferring to novel environments at 85% and 75%. Without SEVO, the same policies achieve only 75%/70% in training and collapse to 30-35% in novel environments. Our results demonstrate that principled observation design and environmental diversity during data collection, not model scaling, enable low-cost robots to operate reliably in everyday household environments.
tldr: The paper introduces SEVO, a data-centric approach combining active illumination, multi-camera coverage, and real-time semantic overlay to improve the cross-environment robustness of VLA-based manipulation policies on real robots.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出SEVO，一种数据为中心的方法，结合主动照明、多相机覆盖和实时语义叠加，以提升基于VLA的机器人抓取策略在真实跨环境部署中的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 基于低成本硬件和社区工具链训练的视觉-语言-动作模型与模仿学习策略，在训练环境之外部署时常常失效。现有评估（包括原始ACT和SmolVLA基准测试）虽然在受控的固定背景下显示出高成功率，但社区实践者反馈其在新环境中的迁移成功率接近零。本文提出SEVO（语义增强虚拟观察）——一种以数据为中心的方法，在不改变策略架构的前提下提升跨环境操作鲁棒性。SEVO通过三种机制转换原始RGB相机流：（1）采用固定于机身的相机群，其组合视场覆盖完整操作空间；（2）通过主动红光照射实现物体外观的物理标准化；（3）实时YOLO分割叠加层提供背景无关的语义提示。关键发现表明，多样化的数据采集协议（在遥操作期间系统性地改变光照、背景和干扰物）是提升泛化能力的决定性因素。我们选取易与环境产生视觉混淆的透明水瓶作为操作对象，并设计简单的抓取放置任务，从而在两个移动平台上完成数百次受控真实机器人实验。完整流程在训练环境中实现ACT 95%与SmolVLA 83%的抓取成功率，在新环境中仍能保持85%和75%的迁移成功率；若不使用SEVO，相同策略在训练环境中仅取得75%/70%成功率，在新环境中更骤降至30-35%。实验结果表明，通过系统的观测设计及数据采集阶段的环境多样化（而非模型扩增），可使低成本机器人在日常家庭环境中实现可靠操作。

title: Reinforcing VLAs in Task-Agnostic World Models
summary: Post-training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models via reinforcement learning (RL) in learned world models has emerged as an effective strategy to adapt to new tasks without costly real-world interactions. However, while using imagined trajectories reduces the sample complexity of policy training, existing methods still heavily rely on task-specific data to fine-tune both the world and reward models, fundamentally limiting their scalability to unseen tasks. To overcome this, we argue that world and reward models should capture transferable physical priors that enable zero-shot inference. We propose RAW-Dream (Reinforcing VLAs in task-Agnostic World Dreams), a new paradigm that completely disentangles world model learning from downstream task dependencies. RAW-Dream utilizes a world model pre-trained on diverse task-free behaviors for predicting future rollouts, and an off-the-shelf Vision-Language Model (VLM) for reward generation. Because both components are task-agnostic, VLAs can be readily finetuned for any new task entirely within this zero-shot imagination. Furthermore, to mitigate world model hallucinations, we introduce a dual-noise verification mechanism to filter out unreliable rollouts. Extensive experiments across simulation and real-world settings demonstrate consistent performance gains, proving that generalized physical priors can effectively substitute for costly task-dependent data, offering a highly scalable roadmap for VLA adaptation.
tldr: Proposes RAW-Dream, a method that disentangles world model learning from downstream tasks by using a task-agnostic world model and a VLM for reward generation, enabling zero-shot fine-tuning of VLA policies entirely within imagination.
tldr_zh: 提出RAW-Dream方法，通过使用与任务无关的世界模型和VLM生成奖励，将世界模型学习与下游任务解耦，使VLA策略可在零样本想象中完成微调。
summary_zh: 摘要：通过强化学习在已学习的世界模型中对视觉-语言-动作模型进行后训练，已成为一种无需昂贵真实世界交互即可适应新任务的有效策略。然而，尽管利用想象轨迹降低了策略训练的样本复杂度，现有方法仍严重依赖任务特定数据来微调世界模型和奖励模型，从根本上限制了其向未知任务的可扩展性。为克服此局限，我们认为世界模型和奖励模型应捕捉可迁移的物理先验知识，以实现零样本推理。我们提出RAW-Dream（任务无关世界梦境中的视觉-语言-动作模型强化），这是一种将世界模型学习与下游任务依赖完全解耦的新范式。RAW-Dream利用在多样化无任务行为上预训练的世界模型来预测未来轨迹，并采用现成的视觉-语言模型生成奖励信号。由于这两个组件均与任务无关，视觉-语言-动作模型可在零样本想象的框架内直接为任何新任务进行微调。此外，为减少世界模型幻觉，我们引入了双噪声验证机制以过滤不可靠的轨迹。在仿真与真实环境中的大量实验均显示出稳定的性能提升，证明通用物理先验能有效替代昂贵的任务相关数据，为视觉-语言-动作模型适应提供了高度可扩展的技术路径。

title: Beyond World-Frame Action Heads: Motion-Centric Action Frames for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have advanced rapidly with stronger backbones, broader pre-training, and larger demonstration datasets, yet their action heads remain largely homogeneous: most directly predict action commands in a fixed world coordinate frame. We propose \textbf{MCF-Proto}, a lightweight action head that equips VLA policies with a Motion-Centric Action Frame (MCF) and a prototype-based action parameterization. At each step, the policy predicts a rotation $R_t \in SO(3)$, composes actions in the transformed local frame from a set of prototypes, and maps them back to the world frame for end-to-end training, using only standard demonstrations without auxiliary supervision. This simple design induces stable emergent structure. Without explicit directional labels, the learned local frames develop a stable geometric structure whose axes are strongly compatible with demonstrated end-effector motion. Meanwhile, actions in the learned representation become substantially more compact, with variation captured by fewer dominant directions and more regularly organized by shared prototypes. These structural properties translate into improved robustness, especially under geometric perturbations. Our results suggest that adding lightweight geometric and compositional structure to the action head can materially improve how VLA policies organize and generalize robotic manipulation behavior. An anonymized code repository is provided in the supplementary material.
tldr: This paper proposes MCF-Proto, a lightweight action head that equips VLA policies with a Motion-Centric Action Frame and prototype-based action parameterization, inducing stable emergent structure and improving robustness in robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出MCF-Proto，一种轻量级动作头，为VLA策略配备运动中心动作帧和基于原型的动作参数化，从而诱导出稳定的涌现结构，并提高机器人操作的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已通过更强大的骨干网络、更广泛的预训练和更大规模的演示数据集快速发展，但其动作头部仍高度同质化：多数模型直接在固定世界坐标系中预测动作指令。我们提出**MCF-Proto**，一种轻量级动作头部，为VLA策略引入了运动中心动作框架（MCF）和基于原型的动作参数化方法。在每个时间步，策略预测一个旋转$R_t \in SO(3)$，在变换后的局部坐标系中通过一组原型组合动作，再将其映射回世界坐标系进行端到端训练，整个过程仅需标准演示数据且无需辅助监督。这一简洁设计催生了稳定的涌现结构：在未使用显式方向标注的情况下，学习到的局部框架形成了稳定的几何结构，其坐标轴与演示的末端执行器运动高度契合。同时，学习表征中的动作变得更为紧凑，其变化可通过更少的主方向捕捉，并通过共享原型进行更有规律的组织。这些结构特性转化为更强的鲁棒性，尤其在几何扰动条件下表现显著。我们的结果表明，在动作头部添加轻量级几何结构与组合结构，能实质性提升VLA策略组织与泛化机器人操作行为的能力。补充材料中提供了匿名代码库。

title: HorizonDrive: Self-Corrective Autoregressive World Model for Long-horizon Driving Simulation
summary: Closed-loop driving simulation requires real-time interaction beyond short offline clips, pushing current driving world models toward autoregressive (AR) rollout. Existing AR distillation approaches typically rely on frame sinks or student-side degradation training. The former transfers poorly to driving due to fast ego-motion and rapid scene changes, while the latter remains bounded by the teacher's single-pass output length and thus provides only a limited supervision horizon. A natural question is: can the teacher itself be extended via AR rollout to provide unbounded-horizon supervision at bounded memory cost? The key difficulty is that a standard teacher drifts under its own predictions, contaminating the supervision it provides. Our key insight is to make the teacher rollout-capable, ensuring reliable supervision from its own AR rollouts. This is instantiated as HorizonDrive, an anti-drifting training-and-distillation framework for AR driving simulation. First, scheduled rollout recovery (SRR) trains the base model to reconstruct ground-truth future clips from prediction-corrupted histories, yielding a teacher that remains stable across long AR rollouts. Second, the rollout-capable teacher is extended via AR rollout, providing long-horizon distribution-matching supervision under bounded memory, while a short-window student aligns to it with teacher rollout DMD (TRD) for efficient real-time deployment. HorizonDrive natively supports minute-scale AR rollout under bounded memory; on nuScenes, HorizonDrive reduces FID by 52% and FVD by 37%, and lowers ARE and DTW by 21% and 9% relative to the strongest long-horizon streaming baselines, while remaining competitive with single-pass driving video generators.
tldr: The paper introduces HorizonDrive, a self-corrective autoregressive world model framework for long-horizon driving simulation, which uses scheduled rollout recovery and teacher rollout DMD to enable stable, long-term rollouts for real-time, closed-loop driving simulation.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了HorizonDrive，一种用于长视野驾驶模拟的自校正自回归世界模型框架，通过计划的滚动恢复和教师滚动DMD，实现稳定、长期滚动的实时闭环驾驶模拟。
summary_zh: 闭环驾驶仿真需要超越短离线段落的实时交互能力，这推动着当前驾驶世界模型向自回归推演方向发展。现有的自回归蒸馏方法通常依赖帧缓存或学生端退化训练。前者因车辆快速运动与场景急剧变化难以有效迁移至驾驶场景，而后者受限于教师模型单次输出的长度，仅能提供有限的监督范围。一个核心问题是：能否通过自回归推演扩展教师模型本身，在有限内存成本下提供无限时长的监督？关键难点在于标准教师模型在其自身预测下会产生偏移，导致提供的监督信号被污染。我们的核心发现是使教师模型具备推演能力，确保其自回归推演过程能提供可靠的监督。基于此，我们提出了HorizonDrive——一种用于自回归驾驶仿真的抗偏移训练与蒸馏框架。首先，调度式推演恢复训练使基础模型能够从被预测污染的时序历史中重建真实未来片段，从而获得在长时自回归推演中保持稳定的教师模型。其次，具备推演能力的教师模型通过自回归推演进行扩展，在有限内存下提供长时域分布匹配监督，同时采用教师推演动态模态分解方法训练短时窗学生模型与之对齐，实现高效实时部署。HorizonDrive在有限内存下原生支持分钟级自回归推演；在nuScenes数据集上，该框架相比最强长时域流式基线将FID降低52%、FVD降低37%，ARE和DTW指标分别减少21%和9%，同时与单次通过的驾驶视频生成模型保持性能竞争力。

title: Dynamic Execution Commitment of Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models predominantly adopt action chunking, i.e., predicting and committing to a short horizon of consecutive low-level actions in a single forward pass, to amortize the inference cost of large-scale backbones and reduce per-step latency. However, committing these multi-step predictions to real-world execution requires balancing success rate against inference efficiency, a decision typically governed by fixed execution horizons tuned per task. Such heuristics ignore the state-dependent nature of predictive reliability, leading to brittle performance in dynamic or out-of-distribution settings. In this paper, we introduce A3, an Adaptive Action Acceptance mechanism that reframes dynamic execution commitment as a self-speculative prefix verification problem. A3 first computes a trajectory-wise consensus score of actions via group sampling, then selects a representative draft and prioritizes downstream verification. Specifically, it enforces: (1) consensus-ordered conditional invariance, which validates low-consensus actions by judging whether they remain consistent when re-decoded conditioned on high-consensus actions; and (2) prefix-closed sequential consistency, which guarantees physical rollout integrity by accepting only the longest continuous sequence of verified actions starting from the beginning. Consequently, the execution horizon emerges as the longest verifiable prefix satisfying both internal model logic and sequential execution constraints. Experiments across diverse VLA models and benchmarks demonstrate that A3 eliminates the need for manual horizon tuning while achieving a superior trade-off between execution robustness and inference throughput.
tldr: This paper introduces A3, an adaptive action acceptance mechanism that reframes dynamic execution commitment for VLA models as a self-speculative prefix verification problem, eliminating the need for manual horizon tuning while improving robustness and inference efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了A3，一种自适应动作接受机制，将VLA模型的动态执行承诺重新定义为一个自我推测的前缀验证问题，无需手动调整执行范围，同时提高了鲁棒性和推理效率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型主要采用动作分块策略，即通过单次前向预测并执行一段连续的低层动作序列，以分摊大规模骨干网络的推理成本并降低每步延迟。然而，将这些多步预测实际部署到现实世界执行时，需权衡成功率与推理效率，这一决策通常由针对各任务预设的固定执行步长所控制。此类启发式方法忽略了预测可靠性的状态依赖性，导致在动态或分布外场景中出现性能脆弱问题。本文提出A3，一种自适应动作接受机制，将动态执行承诺重构为自推断式前缀验证问题。A3首先通过群体采样计算动作的轨迹级共识分数，随后选取代表性草案并优先执行下游验证。具体而言，该机制强制执行：（1）共识排序的条件不变性——通过判断低共识动作在高共识动作条件下重新解码时是否保持一致来验证其有效性；（2）前缀封闭的序列一致性——仅接受从起始位置开始、经连续验证的最长动作序列，从而保障物理执行过程的完整性。因此，执行步长即转化为同时满足内部模型逻辑与序列执行约束的最长可验证前缀。在不同VLA模型与基准测试上的实验表明，A3无需手动调整执行步长，即可在系统鲁棒性与推理吞吐量之间实现更优的权衡。

title: The DAWN of World-Action Interactive Models
summary: A plausible scene evolution depends on the maneuver being considered, while a good maneuver depends on how the scene may evolve. Existing World Action Models (WAMs) largely miss this reciprocity, treating world prediction and action generation as either isolated parallel branches or rigid predict-then-plan pipelines. We formalize this perspective as World-Action Interactive Models (WAIMs), and instantiate it in autonomous driving with \textbf{DAWN} (\textbf{D}enoising \textbf{A}ctions and \textbf{W}orld i\textbf{N}teractive model), a simple yet strong latent generative baseline. DAWN operates in a compact semantic latent space and couples a \emph{World Predictor} with a \emph{World-Conditioned Action Denoiser}: the predicted world hypothesis conditions action denoising, while the denoised action hypothesis is fed back to update the world prediction, so that both are recursively refined during inference. Rather than eliminating test-time world evolution altogether or rolling out the full future in pixel space, DAWN performs a short explicit latent rollout that is sufficient to support long-horizon trajectory generation in complex interactive scenes. Experiments show that DAWN achieves strong planning performance and favorable safety-related results across multiple autonomous driving benchmarks. More broadly, our results suggest that interactive world-action generation is a principled path toward truly actionable world models.
tldr: The paper proposes DAWN, a World-Action Interactive Model (WAIM) for autonomous driving that recursively refines world predictions and action denoising in a latent space, improving long-horizon planning in interactive scenes.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了DAWN，一个用于自动驾驶的世界-动作交互模型，通过潜在空间中的递归世界预测和动作去噪来改进交互场景中的长时程规划。
summary_zh: 场景的合理演化取决于所考虑的驾驶策略，而有效的驾驶策略又依赖于场景可能的发展方式。现有的世界行动模型大多忽略了这种相互依存关系，将世界预测与行动生成视为孤立并行的分支或僵化的"先预测后规划"流程。我们将这种视角形式化为世界行动交互模型，并在自动驾驶领域通过\textbf{DAWN}模型（\textbf{D}enoising \textbf{A}ctions and \textbf{W}orld i\textbf{N}teractive model）实现该框架——这是一个简洁而强大的潜在生成基线模型。DAWN在紧凑的语义潜在空间中运行，通过\emph{世界预测器}与\emph{世界条件行动去噪器}的耦合实现交互：预测的世界假设为行动去噪提供条件，而经过去噪的行动假设又反馈更新世界预测，两者在推理过程中不断递归优化。DAWN既非完全消除测试时的世界演化，也非在像素空间展开完整未来轨迹，而是通过简短的显式潜在空间推演，足以支持复杂交互场景中的长时程轨迹生成。实验表明，DAWN在多个自动驾驶基准测试中均实现了优异的规划性能与突出的安全相关结果。更广泛而言，我们的研究结果表明，世界与行动的交互生成是实现真正可行动世界模型的原则性路径。

title: 3D-Belief: Embodied Belief Inference via Generative 3D World Modeling
summary: Recent advances in visual generative models have highlighted the promise of learning generative world models. However, most existing approaches frame world modeling as novel-view synthesis or future-frame prediction, emphasizing visual realism rather than the structured uncertainty required by embodied agents acting under partial observability. In this work, we propose a different perspective: world modeling as embodied belief inference in 3D space. From this view, a world model should not merely render what may be seen, but maintain and update an agent's belief about the unobserved 3D world as new observations are acquired. We identify several key capabilities for such models, including spatially consistent scene memory, multi-hypothesis belief sampling, sequential belief updating, and semantically informed prediction of unseen regions. We instantiate these ideas in 3D-Belief, a generative 3D world model that infers explicit, actionable 3D beliefs from partial observations and updates them online over time. Unlike prior visual prediction models, 3D-Belief represents uncertainty directly in 3D, enabling embodied agents to imagine plausible scene completions and reason over partially observed environments. We evaluate 3D-Belief on 2D visual quality for scene memory and unobserved-scene imagination, object- and scene-level 3D imagination using our proposed 3D-CORE benchmark, and challenging object navigation tasks in both simulation and the real world. Experiments show that 3D-Belief improves 2D and 3D imagination quality and downstream embodied task performance compared to state-of-the-art methods.
tldr: Proposes 3D-Belief, a generative 3D world model that frames world modeling as embodied belief inference in 3D, maintaining and updating structured uncertainty for partially observed environments, and evaluates it on object navigation tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出3D-Belief，一种生成式3D世界模型，将世界建模视为3D中的具身信念推理，在部分可观测环境中维持和更新结构化不确定性，并在物体导航任务上进行了评估。
summary_zh: 视觉生成模型的最新进展凸显了学习生成式世界模型的潜力。然而，现有方法大多将世界建模框定为新视角合成或未来帧预测，强调视觉真实性而非部分可观测性下具身智能体所需的结构化不确定性。本研究提出一种不同视角：将世界建模视为三维空间中的具身信念推断。基于此观点，世界模型不仅应渲染可见内容，更需在获取新观测时持续维护并更新智能体对未观测三维世界的信念。我们明确了此类模型需具备的若干关键能力，包括空间一致的场景记忆、多假设信念采样、序列化信念更新以及基于语义的未观测区域预测。我们将这些理念实例化为3D-Belief——一种生成式三维世界模型，能够从部分观测中推断显式、可操作的三维信念，并随时间进行在线更新。与先前的视觉预测模型不同，3D-Belief直接在三维空间中表征不确定性，使具身智能体能够推理可能场景补全并对部分观测环境进行推演。我们通过多维度实验评估3D-Belief：针对场景记忆与未观测场景想象的2D视觉质量测试，使用我们提出的3D-CORE基准评估物体级与场景级三维想象力，以及在仿真与真实场景中进行的复杂物体导航任务。实验表明，相较于现有最优方法，3D-Belief在提升2D与3D想象力质量的同时，显著增强了下游具身任务性能。

title: Aligning Flow Map Policies with Optimal Q-Guidance
summary: Generative policies based on expressive model classes, such as diffusion and flow matching, are well-suited to complex control problems with highly multimodal action distributions. Their expressivity, however, comes at a significant inference cost: generating each action typically requires simulating many steps of the generative process, compounding latency across sequential decision-making rollouts. We introduce flow map policies, a novel class of generative policies designed for fast action generation by learning to take arbitrary-size jumps including one-step jumps-across the generative dynamics of existing flow-based policies. We instantiate flow map policies for offline-to-online reinforcement learning (RL) and formulate online adaptation as a trust-region optimization problem that improves the critic's Q-value while remaining close to the offline policy. We theoretically derive FLOW MAP Q-GUIDANCE (FMQ), a principled closed-form learning target that is optimal for adapting offline flow map policies under a critic-guided trust-region constraint. We further introduce Q-GUIDED BEAM SEARCH (QGBS), a stochastic flow-map sampler that combines renoising with beam search to enable iterative inference-time refinement. Across 12 challenging robotic manipulation and locomotion tasks from OGBench and RoboMimic, FMQ achieves state-of-the-art performance in offline-to-online RL, outperforming the previous one-step policy MVP by a relative improvement of 21.3% on the average success rate.
tldr: Proposes flow map policies for fast action generation in RL and a trust-region adaptation method (FMQ) for offline-to-online RL, achieving state-of-the-art on robotic manipulation and locomotion tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出了用于强化学习中快速动作生成的流映射策略，以及一种离线到在线强化学习的信任域适应方法（FMQ），在机器人操作和运动任务上实现了最先进的性能。
summary_zh: 基于扩散模型和流匹配等高表达能力模型类别的生成式策略，非常适合处理具有高度多模态动作分布的复杂控制问题。然而，其强大表达能力伴随着高昂的推理代价：生成每个动作通常需要模拟生成过程的多个步骤，这在连续决策推演中会累积显著的延迟。我们提出流映射策略这一新型生成式策略类别，通过学习在现有流基策略的生成动态中实现任意步长跳跃（包括一步跳跃），从而实现了快速动作生成。我们将流映射策略应用于离线至在线强化学习场景，并将在线适应问题形式化为信任区域优化问题，在保持与离线策略相近的同时提升评判器的Q值。我们通过理论推导得到流映射Q引导算法——一种在评判器引导的信任区域约束下优化离线流映射策略的闭式学习目标。进一步提出Q引导束搜索算法，该随机流映射采样器结合了重噪化与束搜索技术，实现了迭代式推理时优化。在OGBench和RoboMimic提供的12项具有挑战性的机器人操控与运动任务中，流映射Q引导算法在离线至在线强化学习中取得了最先进的性能表现，以平均成功率相对提升21.3%的优势超越了先前的一步策略MVP。

title: Real-Time Whole-Body Teleoperation of a Humanoid Robot Using IMU-Based Motion Capture with Sim2Sim and Sim2Real Validation
summary: Stable, low-latency whole-body teleoperation of humanoid robots is an open research challenge, complicated by kinematic mismatches between human and robot morphologies, accumulated inertial sensor noise, non-trivial control latency, and persistent sim-to-real transfer gaps. This paper presents a complete real-time whole-body teleoperation system that maps human motion, recorded with a Virdyn IMU-based full-body motion capture suit, directly onto a Unitree G1 humanoid robot. We introduce a custom motion-processing, kinematic retargeting, and control pipeline engineered for continuous, low-latency operation without any offline buffering or learning-based components. The system is first validated in simulation using the MuJoCo physics model of the Unitree G1 (sim2sim), and then deployed without modification on the physical platform (sim2real). Experimental results demonstrate stable, synchronized reproduction of a broad motion repertoire, including walking, standing, sitting, turning, bowing, and coordinated expressive full-body gestures. This work establishes a practical, scalable framework for whole-body humanoid teleoperation using commodity wearable motion capture hardware.
tldr: This paper presents a real-time whole-body teleoperation system for humanoid robots using IMU-based motion capture, featuring kinematic retargeting and control pipelines validated through sim2sim and sim2real experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于IMU动作捕捉的实时全身仿人机器人遥操作系统，通过运动重定向和控制流程，在仿真和现实环境中进行了验证。
summary_zh: 稳定、低延迟的人形机器人全身遥操作是一项开放的研究挑战，其复杂性源于人体与机器人形态间的运动学差异、惯性传感器噪声累积、显著的控制延迟以及持续存在的仿真到现实迁移差距。本文提出了一套完整的实时全身遥操作系统，该系统将通过Virdyn IMU全身动捕服记录的人体运动直接映射到Unitree G1人形机器人上。我们设计了一套定制的运动处理、运动学重定向与控制流程，支持连续低延迟运行，无需任何离线缓冲或基于学习的组件。系统首先在基于Unitree G1的MuJoCo物理模型仿真环境中进行了验证（仿真至仿真），随后未经修改直接部署到物理平台上（仿真至现实）。实验结果表明，该系统能够稳定、同步地复现多种运动模式，包括行走、站立、坐下、转身、鞠躬以及协调的全身表达性手势。这项工作为使用商用可穿戴动捕硬件实现人形机器人全身遥操作建立了一个实用且可扩展的框架。

title: DexTwist: Dexterous Hand Retargeting for Twist Motion via Mixed Reality-based Teleoperation
summary: Dexterous teleoperation via Mixed Reality (MR)-based interfaces offers a scalable paradigm for transferring human manipulation skills to dexterous robot hands. However, conventional retargeting approaches that minimize kinematic dissimilarity (e.g., joint angle or fingertip position error) often fail in contact-rich rotational manipulation, such as cap opening, key turning, and bolt screwing. This failure stems from the embodiment gap: mismatched link lengths, joint axes/limits, and fingertip geometry can cause direct pose imitation to induce tangential fingertip sliding rather than stable object rotation, resulting in screw axis drift, contact slip, and grasp instability. To address this, we propose DexTwist, a functional twist-retargeting framework for MR-based dexterous teleoperation. DexTwist detects a tripod pinch, estimates the operator's intended screw axis and twist magnitude, and applies a real-time residual joint-space refinement that tracks turning progress while regularizing the robot tripod geometry. The refinement minimizes a virtual-object objective defined by turning angle, screw axis consistency, fingertip closure, and tripod stability. Simulation and real-world experiments show that DexTwist improves turning angle tracking and screw axis stability compared with a vector-based retargeting baseline.
tldr: DexTwist is a functional twist-retargeting framework for MR-based dexterous teleoperation that improves rotational manipulation by estimating the operator's intended screw axis and applying a real-time joint-space refinement.
tldr_zh: DexTwist是一种基于混合现实的灵巧远程操作功能扭转重定向框架，通过估计操作者意图的螺旋轴并应用实时关节空间细化，以改进旋转操作。
summary_zh: 基于混合现实（MR）接口的灵巧遥操作系统为将人类操作技能迁移至灵巧机器人手提供了一种可扩展的范式。然而，传统以最小化运动学差异（如关节角度或指尖位置误差）为目标的运动重定向方法，在接触密集的旋转操作任务（如开瓶盖、转动钥匙和拧螺栓）中常常失效。这种失败源于本体差异：不匹配的连杆长度、关节轴线/限位以及指尖几何形状，可能导致直接的姿态模仿引发指尖切向滑动而非稳定的物体旋转，从而造成旋转轴漂移、接触滑动和抓取失稳。为解决这一问题，我们提出DexTwist——一种基于MR的灵巧遥操作功能化扭转重定向框架。DexTwist通过检测三指捏合姿态，估计操作者的预期旋转轴与扭转幅度，并实施实时残差关节空间优化，在追踪转动进程的同时规范化机器人三指几何构型。该优化过程以最小化虚拟目标函数为核心，该函数综合考虑转动角度、旋转轴一致性、指尖闭合度及三指稳定性。仿真与实物实验表明，与基于矢量的重定向基线方法相比，DexTwist显著提升了转动角度追踪精度与旋转轴稳定性。

title: From Imagined Futures to Executable Actions: Mixture of Latent Actions for Robot Manipulation
summary: Video generation models offer a promising imagination mechanism for robot manipulation by predicting long-horizon future observations, but effectively exploiting these imagined futures for action execution remains challenging. Existing approaches either condition policies on predicted frames or directly decode generated videos into actions, both suffering from a mismatch between visual realism and control relevance. As a result, predicted observations emphasize perceptual fidelity rather than action-centric causes of state transitions, leading to indirect and unstable control. To address this gap, we propose MoLA (Mixture of Latent Actions), a control-oriented interface that transforms imagined future videos into executable representations. Instead of passing predicted frames directly to the policy, MoLA leverages a mixture of pretrained inverse dynamics models to infer a mixture of latent actions implied by generated visual transitions. These modality-aware inverse dynamics models capture complementary semantic, depth, and flow cues, providing a structured and physically grounded action representation that bridges video imagination and policy execution. We evaluate our approach on simulated benchmarks (LIBERO, CALVIN, and LIBERO-Plus) and real-world robot manipulation tasks, achieving consistent gains in task success, temporal consistency, and generalization.
tldr: Proposes MoLA, a method that transforms imagined future videos into executable robot actions using a mixture of pretrained inverse dynamics models, bridging the gap between video prediction and control.
tldr_zh: 提出了MoLA方法，通过混合预训练逆动力学模型，将预测的未来视频转换为可执行的机器人动作表示，从而弥合了视频预测与控制之间的差距。
summary_zh: 视频生成模型通过预测长时程的未来观测为机器人操控提供了有前景的想象机制，但如何有效利用这些想象的未来进行动作执行仍面临挑战。现有方法要么基于预测帧来制定策略，要么直接将生成的视频解码为动作，二者均存在视觉真实性与控制相关性不匹配的问题。因此，预测的观测强调感知保真度而非以动作为核心的状态转换原因，导致间接且不稳定的控制。为填补这一空白，我们提出MoLA（潜在动作混合模型），这是一种面向控制的接口，能将想象的未来视频转化为可执行的表征。MoLA不直接将预测帧传递给策略，而是利用预训练逆动力学模型的混合来推断生成视觉转换所隐含的潜在动作组合。这些模态感知的逆动力学模型捕捉互补的语义、深度和光流线索，提供了一种结构化且基于物理的动作表征，从而在视频想象与策略执行之间架起桥梁。我们在模拟基准（LIBERO、CALVIN和LIBERO-Plus）以及真实世界机器人操控任务上评估了所提方法，在任务成功率、时序一致性和泛化能力方面均取得持续提升。

title: Learning What Matters: Adaptive Information-Theoretic Objectives for Robot Exploration
summary: Designing learnable information-theoretic objectives for robot exploration remains challenging. Such objectives aim to guide exploration toward data that reduces uncertainty in model parameters, yet it is often unclear what information the collected data can actually reveal. Although reinforcement learning (RL) can optimize a given objective, constructing objectives that reflect parametric learnability is difficult in high-dimensional robotic systems. Many parameter directions are weakly observable or unidentifiable, and even when identifiable directions are selected, omitted directions can still influence exploration and distort information measures. To address this challenge, we propose Quasi-Optimal Experimental Design (Q{\footnotesize OED}), an adaptive information objective grounded in optimal experimental design. Q{\footnotesize OED} (i) performs eigenspace analysis of the Fisher information matrix to identify an observable subspace and select identifiable parameter directions, and (ii) modifies the exploration objective to emphasize these directions while suppressing nuisance effects from non-critical parameters. Under bounded nuisance influence and limited coupling between critical and nuisance directions, Q{\footnotesize OED} provides a constant-factor approximation to the ideal information objective that explores all parameters. We evaluate Q{\footnotesize OED} on simulated and real-world navigation and manipulation tasks, where identifiable-direction selection and nuisance suppression yield performance improvements of \SI{35.23}{\percent} and \SI{21.98}{\percent}, respectively. When integrated as an exploration objective in model-based policy optimization, Q{\footnotesize OED} further improves policy performance over established RL baselines.
tldr: Proposes Quasi-Optimal Experimental Design (QOED), an adaptive information-theoretic objective for robot exploration that selects identifiable parameter directions and suppresses nuisance effects, improving performance in navigation and manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出用于机器人探索的自适应信息论目标QOED，通过选择可识别参数方向并抑制干扰效应，提升了导航和操作任务的性能。
summary_zh: 为机器人探索设计可学习的信息论目标仍具挑战性。此类目标旨在引导探索朝向能够降低模型参数不确定性的数据，但所收集数据实际能揭示何种信息往往难以明确。尽管强化学习（RL）可以优化给定目标，但在高维机器人系统中构建反映参数可学习性的目标却十分困难：许多参数方向具有弱可观测性或不可识别性，即使选定可识别方向，被忽略的方向仍可能影响探索并扭曲信息度量。为应对这一挑战，我们提出基于最优实验设计的自适应信息目标——准最优实验设计（Q{\footnotesize OED}）。该方法（i）通过费雪信息矩阵的特征空间分析识别可观测子空间并选择可识别参数方向；（ii）修正探索目标以强化这些方向，同时抑制非关键参数产生的干扰效应。在干扰影响有界且关键方向与干扰方向耦合有限的条件下，Q{\footnotesize OED} 可为探索所有参数的理想信息目标提供常数因子近似解。我们在仿真与真实世界的导航及操作任务中评估 Q{\footnotesize OED}，结果显示：可识别方向选择与干扰抑制分别实现 \SI{35.23}{\percent} 和 \SI{21.98}{\percent} 的性能提升。当作为探索目标融入基于模型的策略优化时，Q{\footnotesize OED} 能进一步超越现有RL基线方法的策略性能。

title: Closing the Motion Execution Gap: From Semantic Motion Task Constraints to Kinematic Control
summary: This paper addresses the Motion Execution Gap, the disconnect between high-level symbolic task descriptions using semantic constraints and executable robot motions. Motion Statecharts are introduced as an executable symbolic representation for complex motions. They allow the arbitrary arrangement of motion constraints, monitors or nested statecharts in parallel and sequence. World-centric motion specification and generalization across embodiments are enabled through the use of a unified differentiable kinematic world model of both, robots and environments. Motion execution is realized through a lMPC-based implementation of the task-function approach, in which smooth transitions during task switches are ensured using jerk bounds. Cross-platform transferability was demonstrated by deploying the method on eight robot platforms, operating in diverse environments. The proposed framework is called Giskard and is available open source: https://github.com/cram2/cognitive_robot_abstract_machine.
tldr: This paper introduces Giskard, a framework that bridges high-level semantic motion task constraints with executable kinematic control through Motion Statecharts and a differentiable kinematic world model, demonstrated on eight robot platforms.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Giskard框架，通过Motion Statecharts和可微分运动学世界模型，将高层语义运动任务约束与可执行运动控制连接起来，并在八个机器人平台上进行了演示。
summary_zh: 本文针对运动执行鸿沟，即利用语义约束的高层符号化任务描述与可执行机器人运动之间的脱节问题，提出了“运动状态图”作为一种面向复杂运动任务的可执行符号化表示方法。该方法支持以任意并行或顺序方式组合运动约束、监控器及嵌套状态图，并通过对机器人及环境构建统一的可微分运动学世界模型，实现了以世界坐标系为中心的运动规范及跨实体平台的泛化能力。运动执行通过基于线性模型预测控制的任务函数方法实现，其中利用加加速度边界确保了任务切换过程中的平滑过渡。通过在八种不同环境的机器人平台上部署，验证了该方法的跨平台可移植性。该框架被命名为Giskard，已开源发布：https://github.com/cram2/cognitive_robot_abstract_machine。

title: Coordinated Diffusion: Generating Multi-Agent Behavior Without Multi-Agent Demonstrations
summary: Imitation learning powered by generative models has proven effective for modeling complex single-agent behaviors. However, teaching multi-agent systems, like multiple arms or vehicles, to coordinate through imitation learning is hindered by a fundamental data bottleneck: as the joint state-action space grows exponentially with the number of agents, collecting a sufficient amount of coordinated multi-agent demonstrations becomes extremely costly. In this work, we ask: how can we leverage single-agent demonstration data to learn multi-agent policies? We present Coordinated Diffusion (CoDi), a framework that couples independently trained single-agent diffusion policies through a user-defined multi-agent cost function, without requiring any coordinated demonstrations. We derive a new diffusion-based sampling scheme wherein the diffusion score function decomposes into independent, single-agent pre-trained base policies plus a cost-driven guidance term that coordinates these base policies into cohesive multi-agent behavior. We show that this guidance term can be estimated in a gradient-free manner, making CoDi applicable to black-box, non-differentiable cost functions without additional training. Theoretically and empirically, we analyze the conditions under which this composition can faithfully approximate a target multi-agent behavior. We find a complementary role for demonstration data versus the cost function: single-agent demonstrations must cover the support of the desired multi-agent behavior, while the cost function must promote desired behavior from this product of single-agent policies. Our results in simulation and hardware experiments of a two-arm manipulation task show that CoDi discovers robust coordinated behavior from single-agent data, is more data-efficient than multi-agent baselines, and highlights the importance of joint guidance, base policy support, and cost design.
tldr: Coordinated Diffusion (CoDi) uses single-agent diffusion policies guided by a multi-agent cost function to learn coordinated behavior without multi-agent demonstrations, demonstrated on two-arm manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 协调扩散（CoDi）利用单智能体扩散策略，通过多智能体成本函数进行引导，无需多智能体演示即可学习协调行为，并在双臂操作任务中进行了演示。
summary_zh:
摘要：
基于生成模型的模仿学习已证明能有效建模复杂的单智能体行为。然而，在教授多智能体系统（如多机械臂或多车辆）通过模仿学习进行协调时，存在一个根本性的数据瓶颈：随着联合状态-动作空间随智能体数量呈指数级增长，收集足够数量的协调多智能体演示数据变得极其昂贵。本文提出一个核心问题：如何利用单智能体演示数据来学习多智能体策略？我们提出协调扩散模型（CoDi），该框架通过用户定义的多智能体代价函数，将独立训练的单智能体扩散策略进行耦合，且无需任何协调演示数据。我们推导出一种新的基于扩散的采样方案，其中扩散得分函数可分解为独立的单智能体预训练基础策略与代价驱动的引导项之和，该引导项能将基础策略协调为连贯的多智能体行为。我们证明该引导项可通过无梯度方式进行估计，使得CoDi适用于不可微分的黑盒代价函数且无需额外训练。我们从理论与实验角度分析了该组合框架能忠实逼近目标多智能体行为的条件。研究发现演示数据与代价函数之间存在互补关系：单智能体演示数据需覆盖目标多智能体行为的支持域，而代价函数则需促进从单智能体策略乘积中产生期望行为。在双臂操作任务的仿真与硬件实验中，结果表明CoDi能从单智能体数据中发现鲁棒的协调行为，其数据效率优于多智能体基线方法，并凸显了联合引导、基础策略支持域与代价设计的重要性。

title: Offline Policy Evaluation for Manipulation Policies via Discounted Liveness Formulation
summary: Policy evaluation is a fundamental component of the development and deployment pipeline for robotic policies. In modern manipulation systems, this problem is particularly challenging: rewards are often sparse, task progression of evaluation rollouts are often non-monotonic as the policies exhibit recovery behaviors, and evaluation rollouts are necessarily of finite length. This finite length introduces truncation bias, breaking the infinite-horizon assumptions underlying standard methods relying on Bellman equations/principle of optimality. In this work, we propose a framework for offline policy evaluation from sparse rewards based on a liveness-based Bellman operator. Our formulation interprets policy evaluation as a task-completion problem and yields a conservative fixed-point value function that is robust to finite-horizon truncation. We analyze the theoretical properties of the proposed operator, including contraction guarantees, and show how it encodes task progression while mitigating truncation bias. We evaluate our method on two simulated manipulation tasks using both a Vision-Language-Action model and a diffusion policy, and a cloth folding task using human demonstrations. Empirical results demonstrate that our approach more accurately reflects task progress and substantially reduces truncation bias, outperforming classical baselines such as TD(0) and Monte Carlo policy evaluation.
tldr: The paper proposes a liveness-based Bellman operator for offline evaluation of robotic manipulation policies, reducing truncation bias in finite-horizon settings.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于活性（liveness）的贝尔曼算子，用于机器人操作策略的离线评估，以减少有限时域下的截断偏差。
summary_zh: 策略评估是机器人策略开发和部署流程中的基础组成部分。在现代操作系统中，这一问题尤为复杂：奖励通常稀疏，评估轨迹的任务进展往往因策略表现出恢复行为而呈现非单调性，且评估轨迹必须具有有限长度。这种有限长度引入了截断偏差，破坏了依赖贝尔曼方程/最优性原理的标准方法所基于的无限时间假设。本文提出了一种基于"活跃性"贝尔曼算子的稀疏奖励离线策略评估框架。我们的方法将策略评估解释为任务完成问题，并导出一个对有限时间截断具有鲁棒性的保守定点值函数。我们分析了所提出算子的理论特性，包括压缩性保证，并展示了其如何在编码任务进展的同时缓解截断偏差。我们在两个模拟操作任务（分别使用视觉-语言-动作模型和扩散策略）以及一个使用人类演示的布料折叠任务上评估了所提方法。实验结果表明，我们的方法能更准确地反映任务进展，显著降低截断偏差，其性能优于TD(0)和蒙特卡洛策略评估等经典基准方法。

title: OOM-Free Alpamayo via CPU-GPU Memory Swapping for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: End-to-end Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving unify perception, reasoning, and control in a single neural network, achieving strong driving performance but requiring 20-60GB of GPU memory-far exceeding the 12-16GB available on commodity GPUs. We present a framework, which enables memory-efficient VLA inference on VRAM-constrained GPUs through system-level optimization alone, without model modification. Our work proceeds in three stages: (1) Sequential Demand Layering reduces VRAM usage from model-level to layer-level granularity; (2) Pipelined Demand Layering hides parameter transfer time within layer execution time via transfer--compute overlap; and (3) a GPU-Resident Layer Decision Policy, informed by per-module residency benefit analysis, eliminates the residual transfer overhead that pipelining cannot hide. We further propose a performance prediction model that determines the optimal configuration-both the number and placement of resident layers-from a single profiling run with less than 1.3% prediction error across all configurations. Applied to NVIDIA's Alpamayo-R1-10B (21.52GB) on an RTX 5070Ti (16GB), our work achieves up to 3.55x speedup over Accelerate offloading while maintaining full BF16 precision.
tldr: A system-level optimization framework that enables memory-efficient inference for large Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models in autonomous driving, achieving speedups on VRAM-constrained GPUs without model modification.
tldr_zh: 提出一种系统级优化框架，通过CPU-GPU内存交换实现内存高效的大规模视觉-语言-动作模型推理，用于自动驾驶，在显存受限的GPU上实现加速且无需修改模型。
summary_zh: 用于自动驾驶的端到端视觉-语言-动作模型将感知、推理与控制统一在单一神经网络中，虽能实现优异的驾驶性能，但需占用20-60GB的GPU显存，远超消费级GPU常见的12-16GB容量。本文提出一种框架，仅通过系统级优化即可在显存受限的GPU上实现高效能VLA推理，且无需修改模型结构。研究工作分三个阶段推进：（1）顺序需求分层技术将显存占用量化精度从模型级细化至层级；（2）流水线式需求分层技术通过传输-计算重叠机制，将参数传输时间隐匿于层执行时间内；（3）基于模块级驻留效益分析制定的GPU驻留层决策策略，可消除流水线技术无法规避的残余传输开销。我们进一步提出性能预测模型，通过单次性能剖析（预测误差低于1.3%）即可确定最优配置——包括驻留层的数量与布局策略。在RTX 5070Ti（16GB）上应用本框架处理NVIDIA Alpamayo-R1-10B模型（21.52GB）时，相比Accelerate卸载方案实现了3.55倍加速，同时保持完整的BF16精度。

title: SenseNova-U1: Unifying Multimodal Understanding and Generation with NEO-unify Architecture
summary: Recent large vision-language models (VLMs) remain fundamentally constrained by a persistent dichotomy: understanding and generation are treated as distinct problems, leading to fragmented architectures, cascaded pipelines, and misaligned representation spaces. We argue that this divide is not merely an engineering artifact, but a structural limitation that hinders the emergence of native multimodal intelligence. Hence, we introduce SenseNova-U1, a native unified multimodal paradigm built upon NEO-unify, in which understanding and generation evolve as synergistic views of a single underlying process. We launch two native unified variants, SenseNova-U1-8B-MoT and SenseNova-U1-A3B-MoT, built on dense (8B) and mixture-of-experts (30B-A3B) understanding baselines, respectively. Designed from first principles, they rival top-tier understanding-only VLMs across text understanding, vision-language perception, knowledge reasoning, agentic decision-making, and spatial intelligence. Meanwhile, they deliver strong semantic consistency and visual fidelity, excelling in conventional or knowledge-intensive any-to-image (X2I) synthesis, complex text-rich infographic generation, and interleaved vision-language generation, with or without think patterns. Beyond performance, we show detailed model design, data preprocessing, pre-/post-training, and inference strategies to support community research. Last but not least, preliminary evidence demonstrates that our models extend beyond perception and generation, performing strongly in vision-language-action (VLA) and world model (WM) scenarios. This points toward a broader roadmap where models do not translate between modalities, but think and act across them in a native manner. Multimodal AI is no longer about connecting separate systems, but about building a unified one and trusting the necessary capabilities to emerge from within.
tldr: Proposes SenseNova-U1, a native unified multimodal model that integrates understanding and generation, showing preliminary evidence of capability in vision-language-action and world model scenarios.
tldr_zh: 提出SenseNova-U1，一种原生统一的多模态模型，整合理解与生成，初步证据显示其在视觉-语言-动作和世界模型场景中具有潜力。
summary_zh: 当前的大型视觉语言模型(VLMs)仍然受困于一个根本性矛盾：理解与生成被割裂为两个独立问题，导致架构碎片化、流程级联化以及表征空间错位。我们认为这种割裂不仅是工程实现上的缺陷，更是阻碍原生多模态智能涌现的结构性局限。为此，我们提出SenseNova-U1——基于NEO-unify构建的原生统一多模态范式，该框架将理解与生成视为同一底层过程的协同视角。我们发布了两个原生统一变体：基于稠密基座（8B）的SenseNova-U1-8B-MoT和基于混合专家模型（30B-A3B）的SenseNova-U1-A3B-MoT。它们从第一性原理出发设计，在文本理解、视觉语言感知、知识推理、智能体决策和空间智能等任务上媲美顶尖的纯理解型VLM。同时，该模型在语义一致性与视觉保真度方面表现卓越，在常规/知识密集型任意到图像（X2I）合成、复杂图文信息图表生成、以及带/不带思维链的交错视觉语言生成等任务中均展现出优势。除性能表现外，我们还详细阐述了模型设计、数据预处理、预训练/后训练及推理策略，以支持社区研究。初步证据表明，我们的模型已超越感知与生成范畴，在视觉语言动作（VLA）和世界模型（WM）场景中表现强劲。这指向更广阔的发展路径：模型不再只是模态间转换，而是以原生方式跨模态思考与行动。多模态AI不再是连接独立系统，而是构建统一系统，并相信必要的能力将从系统内部自然涌现。

title: PointForward: Feedforward Driving Reconstruction through Point-Aligned Representations
summary: High-fidelity reconstruction of driving scenes is crucial for autonomous driving. While recent feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods enable fast reconstruction, their per-pixel Gaussian prediction paradigm often suffers from multi-view inconsistency and layering artifacts. Moreover, existing methods often model dynamic instances via dense flow prediction, which lacks explicit cross-view correspondence and instance-level consistency. In this paper, we propose PointForward, a feedforward driving reconstruction framework through point-aligned representations. Unlike pixel-aligned methods, we initialize sparse 3D queries in world space and aggregate multi-view image information via spatial-temporal fusion onto these queries, enforcing explicit cross-view consistency in a single feedforward pass. To handle scene dynamics, we introduce scene graphs that explicitly organize moving instances during reconstruction. By leveraging 3D bounding boxes, our method enables instance-level motion propagation and temporally consistent dynamic representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PointForward achieves state-of-the-art performance on large-scale driving benchmarks. The code will be available upon the publication of the paper.
tldr: PointForward proposes a feedforward driving reconstruction framework using point-aligned representations and scene graphs to improve multi-view consistency and dynamic instance modeling for autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: PointForward提出了一种基于点对齐表示和场景图的前馈驾驶重建框架，旨在提升多视图一致性并改进动态实例建模，以服务于自动驾驶。
summary_zh: 高保真度驾驶场景重建对于自动驾驶至关重要。虽然近期基于前馈的3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）方法能够实现快速重建，但其逐像素的高斯预测范式常存在多视角不一致和层状伪影问题。此外，现有方法通常通过密集光流预测建模动态实例，缺乏显式的跨视角对应关系与实例级一致性。本文提出PointForward——一种基于点对齐表征的前馈式驾驶重建框架。与像素对齐方法不同，我们在世界空间中初始化稀疏3D查询点，通过时空融合将多视角图像信息聚合到这些查询点上，在单次前馈过程中强制实现显式的跨视角一致性。为处理场景动态变化，我们引入场景图显式组织重建过程中的运动实例。通过利用3D边界框，本方法实现了实例级运动传播与时间一致的动态表征。大量实验表明，PointForward在大规模驾驶基准测试中达到了最先进的性能。代码将在论文发表后公开。

title: TriBand-BEV: Real-Time LiDAR-Only 3D Pedestrian Detection via Height-Aware BEV and High-Resolution Feature Fusion
summary: Safe autonomous agents and mobile robots need fast real time 3D perception, especially for vulnerable road users (VRUs) such as pedestrians.
